hypothesis: A close through the sweep wick may continue in the breakout direction.
baseline: Ideal gross symmetric barrier breakeven win rate 50%. Descriptive comparison.
higher_timeframe_rules: No higher timeframe filter. Use nonempty observed M1 buckets on saved clock aligned to midnight.
entry_rules: Follow f_levels in source identified below. Process uninterrupted starting 2015-01-01. Confirmed 5+5 pivots. Independently track high/low wick sweep and wait for a subsequent close beyond its extreme. New same-side sweep replaces setup first. Next observed bar open entry, positive risk, one active per direction; long and short may overlap.

exit_rules.execution: SL original swept pivot, TP full 1R rounded to tick. M1 open checked first: stop gaps at open, target at limit. Intraminute dual touch stop first. Final observed 2025 M1 close for open trades.

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously used; splits descriptive only.
search_space: No tuning; replay both requested timeframes.
cost_and_fill_model: Fixed 1 pip round trip deducted from every trade after exit. No extra fees or swaps.
position_sizing_and_currency: One unit initial risk per entry, PF measured in R. No capital curve assumptions.
acceptance_gates: Descriptive only: report gross/net win rates and PF by timeframe, long/short/combined. Positive economic R counts as win. Absolute R <= 1e-10 is breakeven.
cross_symbol_rule: Pool by trade, plus by instrument and three year period. Sensitivity excluding coarse USDCHF M1.
